transcript.content: Hi, I changed my password and now I can't log in to anything.
Let me start with your name and company to verify your account.
Thanks James. When did you change the password?
Yesterday afternoon, as required by IT.
And what exactly happens when you try to log in now?
Invalid credentials on everything — Outlook, Teams, document management.
Is it all devices or just one?
All of them — my desktop, laptop, and phone.
Do you see an MFA prompt?
Yes, but even after approving MFA it still says wrong password.
That's useful. Let me check your account sync status.
I have a court filing at 3pm so this is urgent.
I understand the urgency. I can see your account is locked due to the password change not syncing properly. Let me reset the sync and unlock it now.
About 5 minutes. I'll send a temp password to your manager. You'll set a new one on first login.

ticket.summary: M365 account locked after password change — James Wilson, Mercer & Tate Law. Sync reset, account unlocked, temp password to manager.
ticket.description: User: James Wilson, Mercer & Tate Law. Issue: Cannot log in after password change yesterday. Scope: All devices (desktop, laptop, phone). Error: Invalid credentials, MFA prompts but password rejected. Impact: Cannot access email or document management. Urgency: Court filing deadline at 3pm today. Diagnosis: Account locked due to password change sync failure. Action: Reset sync, unlocked account, temp password sent to manager. Follow-up: User logs in with temp password, sets new password, verifies all apps.

expected.notes: Gold standard login problem handling. Full discovery: identity, scope, impact, urgency, error details, MFA check. Excellent escalation judgement. Classification matches taxonomy Incident > Desktop/Laptop > Login Problem.
